reason: The proposed action attempts to remove specific items from a pending order by calling modify_pending_order_items with empty new_item_ids. However, the policy states that items can be 'modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option' — requiring each old item to map to a new item of the same product type. Removing items entirely (new_item_ids empty) is not modification to a different variant; it is item removal. The policy does not explicitly permit partial order modification (keeping some items while removing others from a pending order). The available actions are: cancel entire order, modify payment method, modify items to different options, or modify address. The tool contract also requires parallel arrays with 1:1 correspondence between item_ids and new_item_ids. This operation falls outside the scope of documented modify_pending_order_items use or requires clarification of whether the backend interprets empty new_item_ids as removal.
policy_references: Modify items: 'For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.'
Generic action rules: 'For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.'
Tool parameter: 'Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.'
